authorityBoundary.statement: This is a local, deployment-ready candidate bundle. It authorizes neither production mutation nor a public-success claim.

ingressRepair.requiredChange: Route the exact /connectivity path to the existing Monitor service before the static application fallback.
invariants: Do not route arbitrary application paths to the Monitor API.
Keep static fallback only for non-API application routes.
Do not alter Monitor environment, service unit, credentials, Faucet runtime, Wallet protocol, or another owner path.

localRouteEvidence.test: P0 public connectivity route is cache-free and truthful before probe activation

monitorConnectivity.classification: static application fallback; not connectivity API

rollback.requiredBeforeMutation: Capture and checksum the active Monitor ingress configuration and current release target.
rollback.onAnyFailure: Restore the captured ingress configuration and exact current release target, validate the proxy configuration, reload it, then prove the prior public version identity.

singleUseLeaseRequest.scope: Explorer, Indexer, Monitor candidate release and Monitor /connectivity ingress route only
bind: candidate source and artifacts in this bundle
authoritative current release and rollback target
approved deployment operator and lease expiry
postDeployChecks: Explorer and Indexer version endpoints identify the candidate source and release.
Monitor version identifies the candidate source and release.
Monitor /connectivity is JSON with the expected schema and never HTML fallback.
Both known Faucet transaction hashes resolve through canonical Explorer routes and indexed APIs expose from, to, amount, fee, block, and status.
Any failed identity, JSON, transaction, or rollback check restores the exact prior release and records the rollback readback.
